title: Terms of Membership: Joining Marlowe & Finch Unlimited
content:
# Terms of Membership — Section 2: Joining Marlowe & Finch Unlimited

**2.1 Who may join.** A customer with a card on file may join any Marlowe & Finch Unlimited plan. Unlimited Student Annual additionally needs the customer's student status verified by SheerID.

**2.2 Free trial.** A trial of the plan's trial length is given only to a customer who has had no Marlowe & Finch Unlimited membership in the last 12 calendar months before the enrollment date and who has had fewer earlier trials than the plan's lifetime limit of trials, which is 1 on every plan. Otherwise the trial length is zero and the first fee is charged on enrollment.

**2.3 Earlier memberships.** For clause 2.2, an earlier membership is any Marlowe & Finch Unlimited membership of the customer, in any status, whose enrollment date or closing date falls within the 12 calendar months before the new enrollment date.

**2.4 Start of benefits.** Benefits start on the enrollment date.

**2.5 Whose benefits.** Benefits belong to the member's own profile only.

**2.6 Rewards points.** The membership fee never earns Marlowe Rewards points.

**2.7 Conversion and auto-renew.** A trial converts into the same plan, and auto-renew starts on.

## What the membership record shows on joining

A new membership opens in status trial, and the enrollment date is the first day of its current period. The trial end date is the enrollment date plus the trial length; where no trial applies, the membership opens as a zero-day trial whose trial end date equals the enrollment date. When a trial ends with auto-renew on, the first fee is charged and the membership becomes active; when a trial ends with auto-renew off, or the first fee is declined, it expires.

## Trial decision table

Clause 2.2 grants the trial only where both conditions hold, and gives the zero-length trial otherwise:

| Any Marlowe & Finch Unlimited membership enrolled or closed in the 12 calendar months before enrollment | Earlier trials fewer than the lifetime limit | Trial given |
|---|---|---|
| No | Yes | The plan's trial length |
| No | No | Zero; first fee charged on enrollment |
| Yes | Yes | Zero; first fee charged on enrollment |
| Yes | No | Zero; first fee charged on enrollment |

## Worked cases (hypothetical customers and dates)

- A customer joining on 20 April whose only earlier membership closed 13 calendar months before that date, and who has never had a trial, receives the plan's trial: the earlier membership closed outside the 12-month look-back.
- The same customer, had that membership closed 11 calendar months before the enrollment date, would receive no trial; the first fee is charged on enrollment.
- A customer with no membership in the look-back but who already used the one trial the lifetime limit allows receives no trial.
- A trial granted on joining Unlimited Standard Annual converts, at its end with auto-renew on, into Unlimited Standard Annual.
